assumptions: Hold the trained generator and the realized perturbation/batch/protocol composition fixed; individual generated cells use independent Gaussian noise, and genes may be correlated.

Primary strata are biological batch crossed with the original prefixB16/extraB32 RNG segment. Repeated groups have iid conditional draws; their n_b*S_b^2/n^2 contributions are unbiased for those groups.

Singleton variances are unidentifiable from this one saved population. The pooled proxy extrapolates only under a common average within-stratum variance assumption. No claim that this assumption holds is made.
interpretation_limits: Keep official all2000-gene MSE and its original60-condition denominator. Any estimator subset is compared with the observed MSE of exactly the same conditions, with coverage reported.
Do not interpret a single-population estimated contribution as a deterministic lower bound, causal error fraction, corrected benchmark score, or independent model-seed uncertainty.
Observed MSE minus the pooled proxy is an assumption-dependent diagnostic and may be negative in a realized sample; do not clip it to zero.
Real validation pseudobulks are held fixed; this does not remove their sampling noise. The old stitched mixedRNG cache remains a diagnostic, not a formal refinement.
No new samples, fitted correction, official metric changes, hyperparameter adoption or test access.
